'''Path of Resistance''' is a featurette for ''[[Star Wars Resistance: Complete Season One]]'' which features an introduction by supervising director [[Justin Ridge]] and the voice actors. It is a look back at [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|season one]], its connection to the [[Star Wars (Hasbro toy line)|''Star Wars'' Hasbro toy line]], and a peek forward into [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|season two]].
